data.content:
## Build Failure Analysis

**Solution:** `BuildDiag.sln` with 3 projects: `Core` → `Services` → `Api`

---

### Root Cause (1 issue)

**`Services/UserService.cs`** — Missing NuGet package reference to `Newtonsoft.Json`

The file uses:
- `using Newtonsoft.Json;` (line 2)
- `using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;` (line 3)  
- `JObject` type (line 22)

But `Services.csproj` has **no PackageReference** to `Newtonsoft.Json` — only a ProjectReference to `Core`.

**3 compiler errors (all same root cause):**
| Error | Location |
|-------|----------|
| CS0246: `'Newtonsoft'` not found | UserService.cs(2,7) |
| CS0246: `'Newtonsoft'` not found | UserService.cs(3,7) |
| CS0246: `'JObject'` not found | UserService.cs(22,19) |

---

### Cascading Failures

- **`Api.csproj`** — Failed targets (`ResolveProjectReferences`, `Build`) because it depends on `Services.csproj` which failed to compile.
- **`Core.csproj`** — Multiple failed targets (e.g. `GetTargetFrameworks`, `Build`) are from the solution-level dependency resolution pass, not from its own compilation errors. Core itself has no code errors.

---

### Fix

Add the missing package reference to `Services/Services.csproj`:

```xml
<ItemGroup>
  <PackageReference Include="Newtonsoft.Json" Version="13.0.3" />
</ItemGroup>
```

This single fix will resolve all 3 errors and unblock the cascading failures in `Api` and `Core`.
